02 — Typography

Type that does the talking.

Title cards, kinetic captions and pull-quotes I designed for Mono Architecture, Season 3. Each episode gets its own type voice: the mood changes, the care doesn't.

04 — Campaigns for brands

Ads I directed, shot and wrote.

I was the creative director, strategist and DoP on each of these for L'Oréal, Zouk, Duroflex, Country Delight, EatFit and Coyu. One recognisable language across all of them: soft light, warm tones, italic serif captions and one idea per film.

CoyuWellness

Say the quiet part out loud.

Shame is the enemy, so I cut the film as a candid confession: minimal subtitles, macro product moments, no gloss.

Creative Director · Strategist · DoP
Worked because: Honest talking-head with macro product cutaways
ZoukBags · Gifting

Chaos, then the box.

The idea: emotion first, product second. Highlighted-word captions mark the beats and the unboxing closes the loop.

Creative Director · Strategist · DoP
Worked because: Unboxing as the emotional payoff
DuroflexSleep

Real sleep, real life.

Told like a diary entry, with captions that carry the story when the sound is off.

Creative Director · Strategist · DoP
Worked because: Sound-off captions carry the story
Country DelightDairy · Daily essentials

Delivered at my doorstep.

Sensory close-ups first, the person second: pour, taste, react.

Creative Director · Strategist · DoP
Worked because: Pour-taste-react in three shots
EatFitFood · Meal plans

The meal is the hero.

A tight cut from talking head to top-down plating to couch-side honesty.

Creative Director · Strategist · DoP

05 — Self-initiated project · Identity & brand system

Dabara. Filter coffee, unfiltered.

A sample brief I set myself, in the spirit of Studio Sorted: a Bangalore filter-kaapi brand for people who grew up on the steel tumbler and now live on oat lattes. Strategy first, then identity, then every application, with play built into the system.

Strategy

Tension: tradition tastes great, but it looks old.
Idea: the tumbler pour, made playful.
Line: Filter. Not filtered.
